question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

No one trusts her as her reasons are always __explicit__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"explicit"** means something that is clear and fully expressed, leaving no room for confusion or doubt. (स्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were** explicit**, so everyone knew exactly what to do.
 
 
 
• **"Ambiguous"** refers to something that is unclear or open to more than one interpretation. (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** The terms of the contract were **ambiguous,** leading to a lot of confusion.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'explicit'** is **'ambiguous'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exact** (सटीक): Something that is precise and accurate.

 
 
• **Example:** He gave the exact measurements needed for the project.
 
 
 
• **Precise** (सटीक): Marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail.
 
 
• **Example:** Her instructions were precise, leaving no room for error.
 
 
 
• **Distant** (दूर): Far away in space or time.
 
 
• **Example:** The distant mountains looked beautiful at sunset.
